name: Jensen Huang
tagline: Accelerating computing to solve the unsolvable.
subtitle: GPU Computing & Deep Learning Systems
bio: Jensen Huang is the AI Architect of the Statistics Programming Club. He focuses on designing high-performance GPU-accelerated computing pipelines, scaling deep learning systems, and mentoring student developers in hardware-software co-design. As the founder of NVIDIA, he has spent over three decades pioneering the GPU revolution and creating the foundation for modern artificial intelligence.
